_comment: Gate 0 baseline (#1212, plan Wave 1 step 1). Captured 2026-08-18 by BaselineCaptureIT against the deployed alpha stack via scripts/run-live-eval.sh, read-only (Flyway disabled, no web server, no Eureka; only the alpha Postgres and the local Ollama embedding container are contacted). Supersedes the 2026-06-30 local 1-container run, whose tool_selection metrics were 0.0 over 3 seed fixtures because they targeted discovered-convention tool names that the live facade tool set does not use. Recall is scored at production's tier-2 cosine floor (mcp.rag.tier2-min-score); see the note in metrics.rag_recall_at_k.

floors._note: Floors are asserted by BaselineCaptureIT and were not modified by this capture.

observations.leakage_guard: forbidden_violations = 0 on both suites; no permission-negative document or tool was ever visible.
observations.rag_recall_scoring_floor: Scored at 0.45, production's mcp.rag.min-score. The test previously hardcoded 0.55, which was production's value for nomic-embed-text before the #1194 bge-m3 cutover recalibrated it. Measured the same day on the same corpus and the same 51 fixtures: 0.6373 at 0.55 versus 0.8922 at 0.45. The earlier figure was a measurement artifact, not a retrieval regression.
observations.partial_coverage: write_gate_safety_pass_rate and the per-tier latency percentiles are still null: BaselineCaptureIT captures only the RAG-recall and tool-selection suites. Write-safety belongs to Gate 6 (#1218) and the tier latencies to Gate 4 (#1216), both of which need the live HTTP harness and are plan Waves 1-2.
observations.fixtures_scored_vs_declared: 51 of 60 rag-retrieval and 75 of 105 tool-selection fixtures scored; the remainder are not scoreable by this IT (no expected-document/tool assertion to measure against) and are exercised by other suites.
